args:
set -eu
umask 077
cache="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/hwpx-plugin"
runner_dir="$cache/launchers/a35ea567c45a1eff143621b4dc1bfb497c71d95d6052f14074a1e6f9c40d9dca/scripts"
mkdir -p "$runner_dir"
runner="$runner_dir/hwpx-automation-mcp"
tmp="$(mktemp "$runner_dir/.launcher.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s' '#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Canonical python-hwpx-automation MCP launcher (hwpx-plugins Feature 066).
#
# Coordinates come from packaging/product-identity.json at build time and are
# cross-checked by scripts/validate_hwpx_plugin.py:
#   VERIFIED_*   the exact pair this plugin release was verified with;
#   CONSTRAINT_* the install window: >= verified, < next major.
# HWPX_STACK_CHANNEL=floor (default) installs the newest pair inside the window
# and refreshes it in the background at most once per
# HWPX_STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS. HWPX_STACK_CHANNEL=verified installs the
# exact verified pair and never refreshes. Once a runtime exists, starting the
# server never waits on the network. A runtime becomes current only after it
# passes the self-check below; the running server'"'"'s directory is never moved
# or deleted underneath it.
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PLUGIN_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"

VERIFIED_SERVER_PACKAGE="python-hwpx-automation[mcp,oracle]==7.0.3"
VERIFIED_CORE_PACKAGE="python-hwpx[preview]==6.3.0"
CONSTRAINT_SERVER_PACKAGE="python-hwpx-automation[mcp,oracle]>=7.0.3,<8"
CONSTRAINT_CORE_PACKAGE="python-hwpx[preview]>=6.3.0,<7"

STACK_CHANNEL="${HWPX_STACK_CHANNEL:-floor}"
case "${STACK_CHANNEL}" in
  floor)
    DEFAULT_SERVER_PACKAGE="${CONSTRAINT_SERVER_PACKAGE}"
    DEFAULT_CORE_PACKAGE="${CONSTRAINT_CORE_PACKAGE}"
    ;;
  verified)
    DEFAULT_SERVER_PACKAGE="${VERIFIED_SERVER_PACKAGE}"
    DEFAULT_CORE_PACKAGE="${VERIFIED_CORE_PACKAGE}"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "HWPX_STACK_CHANNEL must be '"'"'floor'"'"' or '"'"'verified'"'"' (got '"'"'${STACK_CHANNEL}'"'"')" >&2
    exit 64
    ;;
esac
SERVER_PACKAGE="${HWPX_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE:-${HWPX_MCP_SERVER_PACKAGE:-${DEFAULT_SERVER_PACKAGE}}}"
CORE_PACKAGE="${HWPX_PYTHON_HWPX_PACKAGE:-${DEFAULT_CORE_PACKAGE}}"
STACK_AUTO_UPDATE="${HWPX_STACK_AUTO_UPDATE:-1}"
STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS="${HWPX_STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS:-24}"
case "${STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS}" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS=24 ;; esac
STACK_IDENTITY_URL="${HWPX_STACK_IDENTITY_URL:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/airmang/hwpx-plugins/main/packaging/product-identity.json}"

# Expected versions derive from the package requests, never from separate
# literals: a hand-advanced literal drifted once (2.0.1/2.0.2 expected 6.0.2
# against a 6.3.0 pin) and failed every fresh install (hwpx-plugins #26).
# Shapes: exact `name[extras]==X`, local wheel `.../name-X-py3-none-any.whl`.
# Anything else (the floor constraints) yields an empty expectation: the
# self-check then requires importability and a clean capability handshake.
_pinned_version() {
  local spec="$1" base
  case "${spec}" in
    *==*)
      spec="${spec##*==}"
      printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${spec%%[];, ]*}"
      ;;
    *.whl*)
      base="${spec##*/}"
      base="${base%%.whl*}"
      base="${base#*-}"
      printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${base%%-*}"
      ;;
    *)
      printf '"'"'\n'"'"'
      ;;
  esac
}
EXPECTED_SERVER_VERSION="${HWPX_AUTOMATION_VERSION:-${HWPX_MCP_SERVER_VERSION:-$(_pinned_version "${SERVER_PACKAGE}")}}"
EXPECTED_CORE_VERSION="${HWPX_PYTHON_HWPX_VERSION:-$(_pinned_version "${CORE_PACKAGE}")}"
export HWPX_SKILL_VERSION="${HWPX_SKILL_VERSION:-2.1.0}"
if [ "${HWPX_LAUNCHER_EMBEDDED:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  export HWPX_PLUGIN_ROOT="${HWPX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}"
fi

# Editable mode is deliberately opt-in.  Auto-discovering sibling repositories
# can silently select an owner'"'"'s unrelated/main checkout and make candidate
# verification pass against the wrong source.
MCP_REPO="${HWPX_AUTOMATION_REPO:-${HWPX_MCP_SERVER_REPO:-}}"
PYTHON_HWPX_REPO="${PYTHON_HWPX_REPO:-}"

if [ "${HWPX_AUTOMATION_DISABLE_LOCAL_EDITABLE:-${HWPX_MCP_DISABLE_LOCAL_EDITABLE:-0}}" != "1" ] \
  && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  && [ -n "${MCP_REPO}" ] && [ -f "${MCP_REPO}/pyproject.toml" ] \
  && [ -n "${PYTHON_HWPX_REPO}" ] && [ -f "${PYTHON_HWPX_REPO}/pyproject.toml" ]; then
  exec uv run --no-project --no-sources \
    --with-editable "${PYTHON_HWPX_REPO}[preview]" \
    --with-editable "${MCP_REPO}[mcp,oracle]" \
    hwpx-automation-mcp "$@"
fi

if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # No index refresh flags on a per-start path (hwpx-plugins #23): they
    # force a PyPI round-trip every start and fail offline with a valid cache.
    # uvx caches the pair it resolves first; users on this fallback refresh
    # with `uvx --refresh ...` by hand — the managed runtime below is the
    # path that self-updates.
    exec uvx \
      --with "${CORE_PACKAGE}" \
      --from "${SERVER_PACKAGE}" \
      hwpx-automation-mcp "$@"
  fi
  echo "hwpx-plugin requires uv or uvx to install and run ${SERVER_PACKAGE}. Install uv, or set HWPX_AUTOMATION_REPO (HWPX_MCP_SERVER_REPO is the 6.x alias) and PYTHON_HWPX_REPO to local checkouts." >&2
  exit 127
fi

RUNTIME_ROOT="${HWPX_AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_ROOT:-${HWPX_MCP_RUNTIME_ROOT:-${HWPX_MCP_SERVER_VENV:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}/.hwpx-mcp-runtime}}}"
ENV_ROOT="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/envs"
LOCK_DIR="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/install.lock"
RECOVERY_LOCK_DIR="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/install.lock.recovery"
mkdir -p "${ENV_ROOT}"

UV_PYTHON="$(uv python find)"
# The fingerprint keys the *request* (constraint window or exact pin) plus the
# interpreter, not the resolved versions: upstream releases land as new
# generations inside one fingerprint directory instead of new fingerprints.
FINGERPRINT="$(
  "${UV_PYTHON}" - "${SERVER_PACKAGE}" "${CORE_PACKAGE}" "${STACK_CHANNEL}" <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import sys
import sysconfig

payload = {
    "serverPackage": sys.argv[1],
    "corePackage": sys.argv[2],
    "channel": sys.argv[3],
    "runtimeLayout": "generations-v2",
    "implementation": sys.implementation.name,
    "python": platform.python_version(),
    "abi": sysconfig.get_config_var("SOABI"),
    "platform": sysconfig.get_platform(),
}
encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
print(hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest())
PY
)"

ENV_DIR="${ENV_ROOT}/${FINGERPRINT}"
POINTER_FILE="${ENV_DIR}/current"
STATE_FILE="${ENV_DIR}/update-state.json"
STAMP_FILE="${ENV_DIR}/last-check"
REFRESH_LOCK_DIR="${ENV_DIR}/refresh.lock"
REFRESH_LOG="${ENV_DIR}/refresh.log"
mkdir -p "${ENV_DIR}"
export HWPX_STACK_UPDATE_STATE="${STATE_FILE}"

# Prints the active generation directory, or nothing when there is none.
_current_generation() {
  local name
  if [ ! -f "${POINTER_FILE}" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  name="$(cat "${POINTER_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "${name}" in
    gen-*) ;;
    *) return 0 ;;
  esac
  if [ -x "${ENV_DIR}/${name}/bin/python" ] && [ -x "${ENV_DIR}/${name}/bin/hwpx-automation-mcp" ]; then
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${ENV_DIR}/${name}"
  fi
}

# True when the request can move: floor channel and no exact expectation.
_request_is_floating() {
  [ "${STACK_CHANNEL}" = "floor" ] && [ -z "${EXPECTED_SERVER_VERSION}${EXPECTED_CORE_VERSION}" ]
}

# $1 = python; prints "<core> <automation>" ("unknown" when a package is absent).
_installed_versions() {
  "$1" - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version


def _version_of(*names):
    for name in names:
        try:
            return version(name)
        except PackageNotFoundError:
            continue
    return "unknown"


print(_version_of("python-hwpx"), _version_of("python-hwpx-automation"))
PY
}

# $1 = venv dir. Console runs, expectations (if any) match, both packages
# import, and the automation capability handshake is clean. Prints
# "<core> <automation>" on success; any failure is a non-zero exit.
_verify_generation() {
  local dir="$1"
  "${dir}/bin/hwpx-automation-mcp" --help >/dev/null || return $?
  "${dir}/bin/python" - "${EXPECTED_SERVER_VERSION}" "${EXPECTED_CORE_VERSION}" <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import sys
from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, version


def _version_of(*names):
    for name in names:
        try:
            return version(name)
        except PackageNotFoundError:
            continue
    raise PackageNotFoundError(names[0])


expected_server, expected_core = sys.argv[1:]
observed = {
    "python-hwpx-automation": _version_of("python-hwpx-automation"),
    "python-hwpx": version("python-hwpx"),
}
# An empty expectation means the request carried no version (constraint
# window, bare name, VCS URL); importability and the handshake are the check.
expected = {
    name: value
    for name, value in (
        ("python-hwpx-automation", expected_server),
        ("python-hwpx", expected_core),
    )
    if value
}
mismatched = {name: observed[name] for name in expected if observed[name] != expected[name]}
if mismatched:
    raise SystemExit(f"installed HWPX stack version mismatch: {mismatched!r} != {expected!r}")
import hwpx  # noqa: F401
from hwpx_automation.quality import capability_state

state = capability_state()
if not state.get("ok"):
    raise SystemExit(
        "installed HWPX stack failed the capability handshake: "
        + "; ".join(str(item) for item in state.get("skew", []))
    )
print(observed["python-hwpx"], observed["python-hwpx-automation"])
PY
}

# $1 = build dir. Creates the venv, installs the request, verifies. The
# one-time install keeps its index refresh: a just-published version may be
# missing from a stale local index cache. Prints "<core> <automation>".
_build_generation() {
  local build="$1"
  rm -rf "${build}"
  uv venv --quiet --relocatable "${build}" \
    && uv pip install --quiet \
      --refresh-package python-hwpx-automation \
      --refresh-package python-hwpx \
      --python "${build}/bin/python" \
      "${SERVER_PACKAGE}" \
      "${CORE_PACKAGE}" \
    && _verify_generation "${build}"
}

# $1 = build dir, $2 = "<core> <automation>". Moves the build into its
# generation slot, verifies the relocated environment, then repoints `current`
# atomically. Existing generations are never removed or replaced. Prints the
# admitted generation directory; failure leaves the previous pointer intact.
_install_generation() {
  local build="$1" core automation name target
  read -r core automation <<<"$2"
  name="gen-${core}-${automation}"
  target="${ENV_DIR}/${name}"
  if [ -d "${target}" ] && _verify_generation "${target}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -rf "${build}"
  else
    if [ -d "${target}" ]; then
      # An existing process may still lazily import from this directory.
      # Repair into a fresh slot, never replace or remove a live generation.
      name="${name}-repair-$$"
      target="${ENV_DIR}/${name}"
    fi
    mv "${build}" "${target}" || return $?
    if ! _verify_generation "${target}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      rm -rf "${target}"
      return 70
    fi
  fi
  printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${name}" > "${POINTER_FILE}.tmp.$$"
  mv -f "${POINTER_FILE}.tmp.$$" "${POINTER_FILE}"
  printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${target}"
}

# Old generations may still serve long-lived MCP processes. Retain them;
# offline maintenance can reclaim them after all servers have stopped.

# $1 python, $2 installed core, $3 installed automation, $4 latest core,
# $5 latest automation, $6 last error, $7 plugin bundle latest known.
_write_state() {
  local effective_auto_update=0
  if [ "${STACK_AUTO_UPDATE}" = "1" ] && _request_is_floating; then
    effective_auto_update=1
  fi
  "$1" - "${STATE_FILE}" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6" "$7" \
    "${effective_auto_update}" "${STACK_CHANNEL}" "${HWPX_SKILL_VERSION}" <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json
import os
import sys
import time

(path, core, automation, latest_core, latest_automation, error, plugin_latest,
 auto_update, channel, skill) = sys.argv[1:]
state = {
    "schemaVersion": "hwpx.stack-update-state.v1",
    "checkedAt": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"),
    "autoUpdate": auto_update == "1" and channel == "floor",
    "channel": channel,
    "runtime": {
        "installed": {"python-hwpx": core, "python-hwpx-automation": automation},
        "latestAvailable": {
            "python-hwpx": latest_core or core,
            "python-hwpx-automation": latest_automation or automation,
        },
    },
    "pluginBundle": {"installed": skill, "latestKnown": plugin_latest or None},
    "lastError": error or None,
}
tmp = f"{path}.tmp.{os.getpid()}"
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(state, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
os.replace(tmp, path)
PY
}

# $1 = python. Prints the plugin version published at STACK_IDENTITY_URL
# (the marketplace source'"'"'s main), or nothing. Bounded, never fatal.
_fetch_plugin_latest() {
  "$1" - "${STACK_IDENTITY_URL}" <<'"'"'PY'"'"' 2>/dev/null || true
import json
import sys
import urllib.request

try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(sys.argv[1], timeout=3) as response:
        print(json.load(response)["releaseState"]["currentPublic"]["plugin"])
except Exception:
    pass
PY
}

# One refresh pass. Runs only inside the detached job (HWPX_STACK_REFRESH_JOB=1)
# or by an operator invoking the launcher with that variable. Exits 0 on every
# path: a refresh failure is recorded in update-state.json, never surfaced as
# a start failure.
_run_refresh() {
  local current_dir current_python core automation latest_core latest_automation
  local plugin_latest dry_run_output build result new_dir
  if [ "${STACK_AUTO_UPDATE}" != "1" ] || ! _request_is_floating; then
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! mkdir "${REFRESH_LOCK_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
    exit 0
  fi
  trap '"'"'rmdir "${REFRESH_LOCK_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true'"'"' EXIT INT TERM
  touch "${STAMP_FILE}"
  current_dir="$(_current_generation)"
  if [ -z "${current_dir}" ]; then
    exit 0
  fi
  current_python="${current_dir}/bin/python"
  read -r core automation <<<"$(_installed_versions "${current_python}")"
  plugin_latest="$(_fetch_plugin_latest "${current_python}")"
  if ! dry_run_output="$(uv pip install --dry-run --upgrade --python "${current_python}" "${SERVER_PACKAGE}" "${CORE_PACKAGE}" 2>&1)"; then
    _write_state "${current_python}" "${core}" "${automation}" "" "" \
      "refresh: dependency resolution failed: $(printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${dry_run_output}" | tail -n 1)" "${plugin_latest}"
    exit 0
  fi
  latest_core="$(printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${dry_run_output}" | sed -n '"'"'s/^ + python-hwpx==\(.*\)$/\1/p'"'"' | head -n 1)"
  latest_automation="$(printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "${dry_run_output}" | sed -n '"'"'s/^ + python-hwpx-automation==\(.*\)$/\1/p'"'"' | head -n 1)"
  if [ -z "${latest_core}${latest_automation}" ]; then
    _write_state "${current_python}" "${core}" "${automation}" "" "" "" "${plugin_latest}"
    exit 0
  fi
  build="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/.build-${FINGERPRINT}-$$"
  if ! result="$(_build_generation "${build}")"; then
    rm -rf "${build}"
    _write_state "${current_python}" "${core}" "${automation}" "${latest_core}" "${latest_automation}" \
      "refresh: candidate ${latest_core:-${core}}/${latest_automation:-${automation}} failed the self-check; keeping ${core}/${automation}" \
      "${plugin_latest}"
    exit 0
  fi
  if ! new_dir="$(_install_generation "${build}" "${result}")"; then
    rm -rf "${build}"
    _write_state "${current_python}" "${core}" "${automation}" "${latest_core}" "${latest_automation}" \
      "refresh: relocated console self-check failed for ${latest_core:-${core}}/${latest_automation:-${automation}}; keeping ${core}/${automation}" \
      "${plugin_latest}"
    exit 0
  fi
  read -r core automation <<<"${result}"
  _write_state "${new_dir}/bin/python" "${core}" "${automation}" "" "" "" "${plugin_latest}"
  exit 0
}

if [ "${HWPX_STACK_REFRESH_JOB:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  _run_refresh
  exit 0
fi

# Due when the stamp is missing or older than the interval; 0 = always due.
_refresh_due() {
  if [ "${STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS}" = "0" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ ! -f "${STAMP_FILE}" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  [ -n "$(find "${STAMP_FILE}" -mmin +"$((STACK_UPDATE_INTERVAL_HOURS * 60))" 2>/dev/null)" ]
}

# Spawns one detached refresh job. The subshell redirects every fd first so
# the job never inherits the MCP stdio pipes (a held pipe would make the host
# wait on the job). macOS has no setsid; nohup + redirected fds is enough.
_maybe_spawn_refresh() {
  if [ "${STACK_AUTO_UPDATE}" != "1" ] || ! _request_is_floating; then
    return 0
  fi
  if [ -d "${REFRESH_LOCK_DIR}" ] || ! _refresh_due; then
    return 0
  fi
  (
    exec >>"${REFRESH_LOG}" 2>&1 </dev/null
    HWPX_STACK_REFRESH_JOB=1 nohup bash "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" &
  )
}

current_dir="$(_current_generation)"
if [ -z "${current_dir}" ]; then
  acquired=0
  for _attempt in $(seq 1 1200); do
    if [ -d "${RECOVERY_LOCK_DIR}" ]; then
      sleep 0.1
      continue
    fi
    if mkdir "${LOCK_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
      printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$$" > "${LOCK_DIR}/pid"
      acquired=1
      break
    fi
    lock_pid=""
    if [ -f "${LOCK_DIR}/pid" ]; then
      lock_pid="$(cat "${LOCK_DIR}/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    fi
    if [ -n "${lock_pid}" ] && ! kill -0 "${lock_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      if mkdir "${RECOVERY_LOCK_DIR}" 2>/dev/null; then
        current_lock_pid="$(cat "${LOCK_DIR}/pid" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        if [ "${current_lock_pid}" = "${lock_pid}" ] \
          && ! kill -0 "${current_lock_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
          stale_lock="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/install.lock.stale.$$.$_attempt"
          if mv "${LOCK_DIR}" "${stale_lock}" 2>/dev/null; then
            rm -rf "${stale_lock}"
          fi
        fi
        rmdir "${RECOVERY_LOCK_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
      continue
    fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
  if [ "${acquired}" != "1" ]; then
    echo "timed out waiting for the HWPX runtime installation lock" >&2
    exit 75
  fi

  BUILD_DIR="${RUNTIME_ROOT}/.build-${FINGERPRINT}-$$"
  cleanup_runtime_build() {
    rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}"
    rm -rf "${LOCK_DIR}"
  }
  trap cleanup_runtime_build EXIT INT TERM

  current_dir="$(_current_generation)"
  if [ -z "${current_dir}" ]; then
    generation_versions="$(_build_generation "${BUILD_DIR}")"
    current_dir="$(_install_generation "${BUILD_DIR}" "${generation_versions}")"
    read -r generation_core generation_automation <<<"${generation_versions}"
    _write_state "${current_dir}/bin/python" "${generation_core}" "${generation_automation}" "" "" "" ""
    touch "${STAMP_FILE}"
  fi

  trap - EXIT INT TERM
  rm -rf "${LOCK_DIR}"
fi

_maybe_spawn_refresh
exec "${current_dir}/bin/hwpx-automation-mcp" "$@"
' > "$tmp"
chmod 700 "$tmp"
mv -f "$tmp" "$runner"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
export HWPX_AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_ROOT="${HWPX_AUTOMATION_RUNTIME_ROOT:-${HWPX_MCP_RUNTIME_ROOT:-${HWPX_MCP_SERVER_VENV:-$cache/runtime}}}"
export HWPX_LAUNCHER_EMBEDDED=1
exec bash "$runner" "$@"
